_comment: The liveness matrix fixture (HM-799). Every band perf_core branches on is
present, and every one of _liveness_note's THREE return paths fires exactly
once. Deliberately separate from sample-findings.json: that fixture's
revenue/spend is 23100/5600 = 4.125 exactly, a half-up rounding BOUNDARY the
suites assert on (roas == 4.13, not round()'s 4.12), so adding spend or
revenue there would silently move the boundary and delete that check.
Campaigns 3 and 4 are a contrast pair: identical in every field except
'status'. That single field is what separates recently_active from dormant,
so the dormant gate in annotate_anomalies is decidable — with the gate row 4
has flags [] / pre_score 0.0, without it row 4 reproduces row 3's
prior_conversions_value are non-zero while prior_cost is 0 ON PURPOSE:
